application.name: Surgical De-identification (In-Body / Out-of-Body Classifier)
application.description: Binary in-body / out-of-body surgical-video classifier used as a de-identification pre-filter. Pipeline: VideoFileReaderOp (FFmpeg decode) -> TensorPreprocessorOp (NPP resize + normalize) -> InferenceOp (TensorRT de_id.onnx) -> ClassificationPrinterOp (stdout).

changelog.1.0.0: Port from Holohub surgical_deidentification app to holoscan-applications.

data.description: ONNX model and sample MP4 used by the stock config.yaml.

classify.description: Run the full classifier pipeline against the mounted dataset.
